Definition: comparative of G4190; more evil:--more wicked.
BiblicalUsage: Ponerōteros is the comparative, more evil, more wicked. Jesus uses it twice for the same warning: a spirit cast out returns with seven others more wicked than itself, and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that an empty house is an invitation, and a heart swept clean but left unfilled is worse off than before.
